mapping_rules: Inventory entries are hypotheses and coordination metadata, not current repository state.
Adoption status requires a content-addressed conformance artifact and must not be inferred from a README.
Dirty or unrelated checkouts must not be modified during adoption work.
next_evidence: fresh revision and native contract capture for each candidate
additive adapter or research-object fixture in the candidate repository
independent reproduction and owner-authorized external workflow evidence
nonclaims: This inventory does not claim all listed repositories are current, compatible or adopted.
It does not grant authority, licensing, publication or cross-repository write permission.
Agent review cannot substitute for factual adoption or independent reproduction.
